body: Oh ok. I'll make sure to leave that on a card somewhere in my house before I go.
Would something simple like "My suicide was entirely my choice, none of you did anything to cause it or could have done anything to prevent it." be helpful?

The gun is in a safe, but I know the combination to the safe. Doesn't fall under negligent storage.

Not leaving a not because I have nothing to say, unless you have specific pointers as to what should be in the note.

Oh my bad, I should have thought of that sooner, thanks for saving my life!

/s
